description.value:
You select one martial weapon group (e.g. swords, bows, knives) as your signature group. You gain +1 status to damage rolls with weapons from that group and access to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-actions.Item.ClAcWpnDraw00000]{Iaijutsu Draw} class action.
